goal: Review Rust code for unsafe blocks, error handling, panics, concurrency and dependency features.
use: Review Rust code for unsafe blocks, error handling, panics, concurrency and dependency features. Use when asked to review or harden a Rust crate or service.

steps.note: Read the crate setup. Open Cargo.toml, the lock file, the edition and any feature flags.
Check unsafe blocks. Every unsafe block needs a comment that states the invariant it relies on.
Check error handling. Flag unwrap and expect on values from outside the program, and errors turned into panics.
Check panics. Panics in library code or request handlers take the service down.
Check concurrency. Flag shared state without the right wrapper, and blocking calls inside async code.
Report. List each finding with its file and line, severity and the fix.
